# Support

## Documentation

Start with [`docs/README.md`](../docs/README.md). It indexes architecture,
release, operations, audit, and planning documents.

## Installation and product help

Power Pilot is distributed through the Microsoft Store:
<https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9NQJTP1BKP5R>

## Bugs and feature requests

- Search existing issues first.
- Open a bug report or feature request through the issue templates.
- Include the Power Pilot version, Windows build, installation type, and exact
  reproduction steps.
- Write in Turkish or English.

## Security issues

Do not open a public issue. Follow [`SECURITY.md`](SECURITY.md) and email
<info@vellium.dev>; use GitHub private vulnerability reporting if the Security
tab offers it.

## Commercial and pilot support

For licensing, pilot agreements, or deployment questions, contact
<info@vellium.dev> or visit <https://vellium.dev>.

Support is provided on a best-effort basis unless a separate written agreement
states otherwise.
